newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Chart analysts see Zurich poised to rise.
newsitem.headline: Chart analysts see Zurich poised to rise.

text.p: While investors pondered rumours that Zurich Insurance Co might buy U.S. asset manager Scudder, chart analysts on Wednesday agreed Zurich Insurance shares were probably poised for an upward break.

Analysts said the registered share, which had been been trading for the past 10 days in a range of 550 to 575 Swiss francs, had established a firm basis in this range that could act as the springboard for another increase.
"At the moment, Zurich is fighting to break out and up," said Philip Vorndran from Zurich-based asset manager Fincor Finance SA.

Zurich Insurance declined to comment on Wednesday on renewed rumours on the Swiss bourse that it was about to buy Scudder, Stevens & Clark, a New York group with $115 billion in assets under management.
Traders said the rumours had helped boost the Zurich share from 520 Swiss francs at the end of May, when the speculation started.

The Zurich-Scudder rumours are the latest twist in market speculation since late April that Scudder may be acquired by a bigger partner, with other possible suitors seen including Union Bank of Switzerland, Chase Manhattan Corp and First Union Corp.
The Zurich share has been rising along with the rest of the Swiss bourse.
But chart analysts said if the share closes above 575 swiss francs, it would have potential to move towards 600 to 620 Swiss francs, said Zuercher Kantonalbank's Jost Mathis.
Mathis said the share should hit 620 francs by mid-July even though it could temporarily test support at 550 francs if the price sinks below 575 again.
